title: Fixed scripts/acceptance_audit.py false failures when auditing the repository checkout root (--site .)
detail: Running python -m scripts.acceptance_audit --site . previously failed check_mobile (by scanning node_modules/playwright-core/lib/vite/traceViewer/snapshot.html via rglob('*.html')) and check_snapshot_consistency (by comparing live root index.html published by scripts.root_publish against git-tracked CI replay fixture data/latest.json). Updated check_mobile to skip non-published directories (SKIP_HTML_DIRS) and updated _snapshot / check_snapshot_consistency to recognize the branch-root split documented in scripts/root_publish.py.
